name: ensoniqplaystereo
description: ensoniqplay placed stereo: pan.wav (16-bit stereo, ~26460 frames/ch) plays as true stereo -- left channel uploaded to DOC RAM $0000 on oscillator 0 (DOC channel 0 = left), right to $8000 on oscillator 1 (channel 1 = right), both one-shot.  'stereo' proves the size dispatch chose the two-oscillator path and 'halted after 7' (~72 ticks; 26460/22050 = 1.2 s) proves both oscillators clocked through their channel.  L/R output separation was confirmed by capturing MAME's per-channel audio (left on output ch1, right on ch2).  Baked at /root/audio.
